name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingInitializeStored.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of root reporting initialization from stored catalogs
natural_language_statement:
Let finite decidable index types carry finite sets A,B,C and integer maps $a,b,c$. Fix modulus/shift $p,\delta$, parameters $h,J$, and wanted label $w$ whose A index belongs to A and whose lifted A residue plus offset equals the output key modulo the global modulus. Let $I$ be the resulting raw-incidence set on A×B×C. Suppose memory stores both exact source transforms, the level-zero catalog and its five-cell metadata, and the correct local child count in the cover header. Their complete level-bound contract places retained data below root destination $r$; the source-query scratch contract fits; metadata and relevant cover cells end before $r$; and the root slot with capacity $(m_0+1)G(h)$ ends before the mask buffer, where $m_0$ is root raw mass. Assume addresses fit words and depth $d+2W+14$ is allowed for global width $W$. The fixed initializer executes the root query, writes the exact depth-zero frontier slot, stores $m_0$ and its computed capacity, returns the root frontier length, meets its stated time and preserves memory below $r$.

This creates a physically bounded reporting frontier from an actual exact root query rather than supplied mass or capacity advice.
explanation: This creates a physically bounded reporting frontier from an actual exact root query rather than supplied mass or capacity advice.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingPrefixCatalog.program_meets
theorem_title: Execution of every prefix catalog at one reporting level
natural_language_statement:
Let $h,J,k\in\mathbb N$ with $k\le J$, global width $W=J\cdot464h$, suffix width $V=(J-k)464h$, source cutoff $c\le W$ and box cutoff $b\le V$. Let integer subset functions $f,g$ be bounded by $B,D$ through cardinality $c$, with $kh+b\le c$, and suppose memory stores their complete source transforms. Reserve in order a local subset row, two local endpoint rows, two exact radix-product stage areas, a pointer array, all suffix-box payloads, a mask buffer and scratch. Assume every preceding reservation ends before the next; local-pair and global Pascal/power scratch fit; the stated power, radix, compact-address and signed-value word bounds fit; addresses fit words; and both depth bounds $d+464h+k+5$ and $d+W+14$ are allowed. The fixed catalog program enumerates every original depth-$k$ prefix, writes both full endpoint-mask rows and the exact count, writes each box pointer and every corresponding signed suffix transform, retains both source transforms and meets its stated time. It returns the left count-cell address and preserves memory below the local subset row.

This constructs every persistent prefix-query catalog with the same original ordered prefix identities.
explanation: This constructs every persistent prefix-query catalog with the same original ordered prefix identities.

name: ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSourceBandBankBatch.Procs.meets
theorem_title: Execution of every independent source-band bank entry
natural_language_statement:
Let $f_L,f_R:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, original lengths $N_L,N_R$, positive band size $g$, arithmetic modulus $p$, signed shift $\delta$, parameters $h,J$ and cutoff $c\le W=J\cdot464h$ be given. Suppose memory stores the exact paired original-source bucket catalog and the complete occurrence array, selected cover maps, candidate indices and bucket counts. All retained data end before bank base $b$, and occurrence rows agree with the representative of every source occurrence code. Assume addresses fit words, the complete packed bank through all independent band slices fits memory, its step word bound fits and depth $d+W+13$ is allowed. With the literal batch closure present, the program constructs

$$\operatorname{At}(\nu,f_L,f_R,b,N_L,N_R,g,h,J,c,p,\delta,i)\quad\text{for every valid band-pair slice }i,$$

within its prescribed full-batch time, preserving every cell below $b$.

This realizes the full reusable source-bank collection across independent B/C band choices.
explanation: This realizes the full reusable source-bank collection across independent B/C band choices. Every source-band slice receives complete transforms for the original left and right values under the same occurrence code.
